product.title: Private Kyoto Tour with Licensed Guide & Vehicle (Max 15 persons)

description.text: In Kyoto, this private six-hour charter pairs a licensed guide with a vehicle and door-to-door hotel transfers instead of public-transport walking. The group chooses three or four published sights such as Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine, Nijo Castle, Kiyomizu-dera Temple, Nishiki Market, Gion, the Kyoto Imperial Palace, or Kinkaku-ji. Pickup is listed for Kyoto-area hotels or Kyoto Station, not Osaka, Kobe, or Nara. Entrance fees, lunch, and personal expenses stay separate. The format suits visitors who want licensed commentary and a private van without navigating the city bus network. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Fushimi Inari, Nijo Castle, and Kiyomizu-dera that define this vehicle window rather than a Nara park add-on.
